visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy with short black hair sits at a wooden desk, hunched over a white workbook. He holds a mechanical pencil in his right hand, poised to write. On the desk, a tablet displays a digital interface and a purple Gengar plushie sits beside a basketball on a shelf behind him. Warm, focused light illuminates the scene. (2) The boy looks down at the page, his expression concentrated. He uses the eraser end of the pencil to rub out a mistake on the paper. The camera moves to a closer angle of the workbook, showing Chinese characters and English text. Yellow and white captions appear briefly at the bottom. (3) A woman's hands enter the frame from the side, pointing to specific words in the workbook. The boy looks up, smiling and laughing. A small circular inset showing the woman's face (wearing a hat) appears in the corner. (4) The boy rests his hand on his head, looking frustrated but amused. Cartoon stars and a 'headache' graphic appear over his head. The background shelf with books, including one titled 'Reveal MATH', remains visible in the soft-focus background. (5) The boy picks up a white stylus and begins drawing large, jagged strokes on the tablet screen to demonstrate a character. He is laughing heartily. A cartoon hammer icon and a large '!' graphic are overlaid on the tablet screen as he works. (6) The boy points at the tablet screen with his stylus, looking at the camera (or the person filming) with a wide grin. Multiple layers of large text and emojis appear on screen as the camera stays focused on his animated face and the desk setup.
